reviews.title: Easy File Storage at a Great Price
reviews.comment: Picked this up to have some affordable storage for large video files that I don’t need to constantly be accessing. Installation was super easy and I had this in my desktop within minutes. I wouldn’t run software off this because I’m too spoiled by my fast NVME drives but this is perfect for file storage.
